hypothesis: Bounded query expansion over already-sanitized Latin tokens may recover inflectional variants (e.g. delivered↔delivery) on the existing simple FTS index without changing ranking or schema.
expected_improvement: Lexical-variation misses recover the decisive span; total correctness, decisive recall, and unanswerable precision do not drop.
security_invariants: user tokens never inject tsquery operators
prefix :* atoms originate only from the expander
performance_budget: FTS statement timeout remains 200ms; mean fts_latency_ms must stay below that timeout and must not exceed 2× the same-harness control mean.
required_tests: Gate M gold extractive benchmark (isolated FTS)
Gate P BEN_EXISTING_FTS regression vs committed baseline
rollback_strategy: Leave BEN_FTS_LEXICAL_EXPAND unset/off. Do not merge. Do not deploy. Production retrieval path is unchanged while the flag is off.
